title: C. C. GLASS
text:
C. C. GLASS.

Savoy has an up-to-date confectionery and cold drink stand owned and operated by C. C. Glass. He carries a nice line of fresh confections and drinks and through the summer he has a cream parlor[.]
notes: Text is cut off at the bottom of the clipping. Business profile/advertisement from early Savoy publication. Last word 'parlor' and any continuation is truncated.
